newsitem.title: USA: Tenneco sees US Gulf gas back in a few days.
newsitem.headline: Tenneco sees US Gulf gas back in a few days.

text.p: Tennessee Gas Pipeline said Thursday it expects to restore in the next few days the 260 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) of natural gas production in its system shut due to cold weather in the U.S. Gulf.

"About 260 million was shut in today, which is only about six percent of our total. No deliveries have been affected. We should be bringing all of it back within the next few days as temperatures warm," a company spokesman said.
Total capacity on the system is about 1.4 billion cubic feet per day, he said.

The lost production was caused by freezing temperatures affecting wellheads at gas fields in southern Texas, onshore and offshore Louisiana fields. These fields feed into the system's 800, 500 and 100 pipelines.
